ctx.x: Just like Charles' orchestra was Pierrot's second band. I see. Because Pierrot, you see when he left and went to New York, I'm the one who took his place playing those, do you remember, I was standing at afternoon teas where nobody else played there with him but him. Pierrot was the only one who played the afternoon tea. He used to do a string instrument, you see, nothing but string.
Well first was the Silver Leaf, and then was which? The Maple Leaf. Then Charles' orchestra. And you joined the Maple Leaf about what time?
